title: Grateful Dead Live at Easttown Theatre on 1971-10-23

ai_review.summary: Low‑generation audience recording of an autumn ’71 show with a modest setlist but subdued performance
ai_review.review: The fan notes that the FM capture is “low gen” and not worth downloading, citing a lackluster vibe on songs like Bertha. While the set list was generous and Jerry’s post‑set reassurance (“Everything's gonna be alright”) is appreciated, the overall energy feels muted.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; it praises the setlist but criticizes recording fidelity and performance energy, leading to an average combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the tape as "low gen" and says they won't download or burn it; suggests noticeable degradation and lack of clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Setlist was generous and didn’t short‑change the audience, showing professionalism despite low energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Delivered a spoken message after the first set: "Everything's gonna be alright."
